{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
valid_sales = sales[
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Filter out missing age (customer_age == -1)
valid_age = valid_sales[valid_sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of valid customers
mean_age = valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of customers (excluding missing age, QA orders, and refunded orders): {mean_age}")"}
